description: Search the numbers available to buy on the brand's own Twilio or Telnyx account: by country (2-letter, default US), type (local, toll_free, mobile), areaCode, digits the number contains, region (state), postalCode or locality, and capability (sms, mms, voice). Returns each number with its place, capabilities and, on Telnyx, its monthly cost. Nothing is bought. Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: search_phone_numbers
title: Search phone numbers to buy
